caption: The Zapier home page right after the onboarding: a banner with 14 TRIAL DAYS LEFT and the line that the paid features are open for the trial, the Copilot box What would you like to automate? The tiles Zap, Agent, Table, MCP and Form under Start from scratch, and at the bottom left Plan tasks 0 / 1.000 and Zapier Pro trial ends Dec 2 with a Manage plan link. The avatar at the top right is covered.

The tab Task usage of Zap history after the five test runs: the banner Welcome to your Professional trial! You have 14 days to try Zapier's paid features, the date range Last 30 days: 10/20/2026 - 11/18/2026, the message No results found, and at the bottom left Plan tasks 0 / 1.000 and Zapier Pro trial ends Dec 2. The avatar at the top right is covered.

The page Select your plan and task tier in euros with Annual selected and Save 33%: Free is the Current plan at €0 with 100 tasks /mo; Professional shows €27,93 struck through and €18,62 /mo Billed Annually with 750 tasks /mo; Team shows €96,40 struck through and €64,26 /mo Billed Annually with 2,000 tasks /mo and 25 users. The panel on the right says Annual total €0 for the Free plan and the Checkout button is grey.

The same page with Monthly selected: Professional €27,93 /mo Billed Monthly with 750 tasks /mo and the features Multi-step Zaps, Unlimited Premium apps, Webhooks, AI fields and Conditional form logic; Team €96,40 /mo with 2,000 tasks /mo; Free stays the Current plan at €0 with 100 tasks /mo and Two-step Zaps. The panel on the right says Professional with 750 tasks, Monthly total €27,93, a Checkout button and Save €111,76 per year with annual billing. Nothing was clicked.
